name: Songkran
when: 13-15 April 2027, nationwide
summary: Thai New Year water festival, celebrated all over Thailand.
details: Water fights and temple visits for the Thai New Year in every town. The stars mark the best-known places to join in.

highlights.name: Chiang Mai
highlights.note: Largest street celebrations, around the old city moat.

highlights.name: Bangkok (Silom and Khao San)
highlights.note: Big water-fight streets in the centre.

highlights.name: Pattaya
highlights.note: Celebrations run a few days longer than elsewhere.

name: Loy Krathong and Yi Peng
when: 24 November 2026, 13 November 2027 (full moon of the 12th lunar month; sources differ by a day), all over Thailand
summary: Krathong floats and lanterns on the full moon of the 12th lunar month, in every town; Yi Peng lantern release in Chiang Mai.
details: Krathong floats are set on rivers and ponds across Thailand. Chiang Mai adds Yi Peng, with thousands of sky lanterns released the same nights.

highlights.name: Chiang Mai (Yi Peng)
highlights.note: Mass sky-lantern release; the most famous celebration.

name: Awa Odori
when: 12-15 August 2027
summary: Japan's largest dance festival, in Tokushima.
details: Dance groups parade through Tokushima over four nights during Obon.

name: Gion Matsuri
when: the whole of July, floats on 17 and 24 July
summary: Kyoto's month-long summer festival with float processions.

name: Sapporo Snow Festival
when: early February 2027
summary: Snow and ice sculptures in Odori Park.

name: Harbin Ice and Snow Festival
when: January to February
summary: Large ice sculptures and lit snow parks, deep winter.

name: Comiket
when: twice a year, August and late December
summary: Giant self-published comics convention at Tokyo Big Sight.
crowd: Hundreds of thousands of visitors over the event days; nearby trains and hotels are very busy.
price: Hotels near Tokyo Big Sight rise.

name: Silver grass festival, Haneul Park
when: October
summary: Fields of silver grass in Haneul Park, Seoul, in autumn.

name: Chuseok
when: 15th day of the 8th lunar month: 25 September 2026, 15 September 2027, 3 October 2028 (the holiday runs a day either side)
summary: Korean harvest holiday with many events and festivals.
perk: Free entrance to the palaces and to many events and festivals.

name: Golden Week
when: 29 April to 5 May
summary: Run of Japanese public holidays.
details: Often described as busy, but little effect has been noticed in practice.

name: National Book Fair and Bangkok International Book Fair
when: late March to early April (55th edition listed for 24 March to 4 April 2027), and Book Expo Thailand in late October
summary: Thailand's two big book fairs at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre.
details: The spring National Book Fair also hosts the Bangkok International Book Fair. The autumn edition is branded Book Expo Thailand (23 October to 1 November in 2026). The 2027 spring dates come from a single Thai calendar and the autumn dates repeat 2026.

name: Taipei International Book Exhibition
when: 16-21 February 2027
summary: Taiwan's biggest book fair, at the Taipei World Trade Center.

name: Beijing International Book Fair
summary: Large annual publishing fair in Beijing.

name: Hong Kong Book Fair
when: about 14-20 July 2027
summary: Week-long book fair at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, very popular with locals.
crowd: Extremely crowded; some days are shut to new entries.

name: Seoul International Book Fair
when: late June (2027 dates not announced; 2026 was 24-28 June)
summary: Seoul's main book fair, held at COEX.

name: Kuala Lumpur International Book Fair
when: late May to early June (2027 dates not announced; 2026 was 29 May to 7 June)
summary: Ten-day book fair at the World Trade Centre Kuala Lumpur.

name: Manila International Book Fair
when: mid September (2027 dates not announced; 2026 was 9-13 September)
summary: Philippine book fair at the SMX Convention Center.

name: Canton Fair (China Import and Export Fair)
when: 15 April to 5 May and 15 October to 4 November (2027 phases listed as expected)
summary: China's largest trade fair, in Guangzhou, in three phases each spring and autumn.
details: Trade visitors only. Hotels in Guangzhou fill and rise sharply during the phases.

name: Computex Taipei
summary: Large computing and electronics show at the Nangang Exhibition Center.

name: Tokyo Game Show
when: 16-20 September 2027 (public days at the end)
summary: Japan's biggest video game show, at Makuhari Messe.

name: AnimeJapan
when: late March (2027 dates not announced; 2026 listed as 28-31 March)
summary: Anime industry fair at Tokyo Big Sight.

name: Dragon Boat Festival (Tuen Ng), Hong Kong
when: 9 June 2027 (fifth day of the fifth lunar month)
summary: Dragon boat races in Victoria Harbour, Stanley and Aberdeen, and a public holiday.
details: Races run in several harbours; the date follows the lunar calendar.

name: Dream Yosacoy Festival
when: first full weekend of November, Odaiba and Marunouchi, Tokyo (7-8 November 2026, 6-7 November 2027)
summary: One of Tokyo's largest traditional-meets-modern dance festivals, with thousands of dancers.
details: A yosakoi dance festival: thousands of dancers with naruko clappers, night projection-mapping collaborations at the Odaiba Statue of Liberty, and live performances around Fuji Television Plaza and Marunouchi. It is always held on the first full weekend of November.

highlights.name: Odaiba (Statue of Liberty, Fuji Television Plaza)
highlights.note: Night projection mapping and dance stages.
